messages:
Alex Kim: fyi, auto-fallback flipped twice in prod last night, created a weird latency oscillation. looking for traceability.
Mira Patel: where do we currently record the per-attempt reasons? I can only find the final decision log from the router.
deploy-bot: AutoFallback executed route=chat-stream-prod time=2026-03-01T02:14:08Z decision=fallback variant=cheap-cpu-2 reason=kv-cache-miss trace_id=trc_9f3a
Jonah Li: we only emit that final trace_id today. we should emit stage-level ids and a small breadcrumb for each attempt (latency, node, quota)
Sam R.: strongly agree. without attempt breadcrumbs it's impossible to know whether it was cache, short-circuit, or quota.
Leah Ortiz: UX ask: console needs a compact "fallback history" view with an expand-to-playback action. playback should let ops replay the original headers and see per-attempt decision points.
Taylor Ng: also require override RBAC and attach a TTL + free-text justification on any manual toggle. default TTL = 15m or 1000 requests.
Mira Patel: sketch for a proto we could emit (policy_trace):
```json
{"trace_id":"trc_<uuid>","route":"chat-stream-prod","attempts":[{"ts":170,"node":"gpu-10","reason":"latency>250ms","quota":"ok"},{"ts":172,"node":"cpu-fallback-3","reason":"kv-cache-miss","quota":"throttled"}],"decision":{"mode":"fallback","variant":"cheap-cpu-2"},"model_hash":"md5:abc123","token_est":42}
```
Jonah Li: include deployment_tag and rollout_id too so we can join with recent deploys and TTL/variant history.
Alex Kim: good call. and add an enum-coded why_reason for analytics (e.g., CACHE_MISS, LATENCY_P99, QUOTA_EXCEEDED).
Sam R.: operations perspective: surface a retro list of fallbacks with severity and whether an override happened + who did it. we need alerts when fallback rate crosses threshold.
Leah Ortiz: UI flow: 1) list of recent fallbacks 2) click to open detail pane 3) timeline with attempts + decision nodes 4) playback slider 5) override button (RBAC, TTL, comment). also a link to raw proto for audits.
Taylor Ng: retention policy: default 90 days, exportable JSON for compliance, and S3 archival for longer legal holds. notify security before changing retention.
Mira Patel: I'll implement the proto and start emitting stage-level breadcrumbs. will put a small schema with versioning so old events remain readable.
Jonah Li: i'll instrument router to attach model_hash, token_estimate, deployment_tag, and attempt-level timestamps.
Sam R.: I'll prototype the ops table and sketch the alert rules (fallback-rate > 1% over 5m or any high-sev event triggers paging).
Leah Ortiz: i'll mock the playback UI in Figma and show the decision timeline + override modal. will include a cost delta estimate from Optimize.
Taylor Ng: I'll draft enum taxonomy for reasons and the retention policy doc to share with security/legal.
Alex Kim: action items recap: (1) Mira + Jonah implement telemetry proto + router instrumentation, (2) Leah + Sam prototype UI + alerts, (3) Taylor draft retention + enums. RFC end of week, proto changes in next sprint.
Mira Patel: noted. i'll open the proto PR and link here when ready.
Jonah Li: will prepare a small compatibility shim for older traces so playback doesn't explode.
Sam R.: i'll post the alert playbook and a runbook snippet for manual override rollback.
Leah Ortiz: will post Figma link and a short demo video when prototype is ready.
Taylor Ng: i'll send the retention draft to security and include audit export examples.
Alex Kim: thanks team. once we have proto + router bits, let's run a synthetic to validate playback + cost estimates before shipping.
Mira Patel: sounds good — will also add an opt-in verbose-mode for a short window so we can gather richer samples in prod without blowing up storage.
Jonah Li: one more: add a checksum of the request headers on the trace so we can match upstream client logs without storing PII.
Alex Kim: perfect. keep updates in this thread and ping me if blockers pop up :thumbsup:
